answer: A remote attestation quotes the enclave code before the identity is allowed to act, and the chain groups identities by quoted measurement, so a farm running one image in one fleet collapses into a single counted voter. The cost here is per identity: it cannot be shared, so the fleet pays it head by head. The ledge is the quoted measurement, the karst the group it forms, and the ferrous the voice that group is worth; the ledge and the karst collapse a farm, while only a fresh ferrous of hardware escapes the grouping.
